description: This file defines the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy class which extends PurgeStrategy and implements logic to purge and modify entities by replacing certain field values using specified formatting strategies. It is part of a plugin system within OrangeHRM, specifically within the maintenance purge strategy component.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class for purging entities by replacing certain fields with formatted values, using configurable strategies.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Retrieves entities matching given criteria and purges them by replacing field values.

methods.name: purgeRecord
methods.description: Replaces fields in a given entity with formatted values and persists the change.

methods.name: getReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a formatting strategy based on the class name.
